name: ret global shared
code:

def mk():
    return G

y = mk()

code:

name: ret param
code:
def mk(a):
    return a
G = []
x = mk(G)
y = mk(G)

name: closure counter
code:
def counter():
    c = [0]
    def inc():
        c[0] += 1
        return c[0]
    return inc
f = counter()
g = counter()
print(f(), f(), g(), g())

name: closure shared
code:
def counter():
    global Z
    Z = [0]
    def inc():
        Z[0] += 1
        return Z[0]
    return inc
f = counter()
g = counter()
print(f(), f(), g(), g())
